title: Really, Light and Heat Obstructa II
description: Really, Light and Heat Obstructa II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Taxman Jones

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 3 Ice Mutant Unipsycho Leaders and 3 Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders in Lower Frump's Misfortune and Return to Taxman Jones in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Taxman Jones

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 3 Ice Mutant Unipsycho Leaders and 3 Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders in Lower Frump's Misfortune and Return to Taxman Jones in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

I'm going to extremes here, but The Frump can't continue to ignore me without paying the price. Head into the main Areas of Lower Frump's Misfortune and cut down any Ice Mutant Unipsycho and Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders you can find. Maybe, if I can keep up the pace, The Frump will take notice. Make your way back to me, Taxman Jones, here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when you are done.

Turn-in:

Good job. I'll be here all day so let me know when you are ready to head back out.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Mutant Unipsycho Leaders
  • Slain Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders

Level range: 35–50
